settings.layer1_body:
Radiant Life™ operates on structured biological timelines.

Our refund policy exists to support fairness and institutional trust — not to accelerate enrollment decisions or reduce seriousness of participation.

A completed protocol with neutral or unremarkable documentation remains valid participation.

Refund decisions reflect fairness standards, not system failure.

settings.title: When Refunds Apply
settings.body: Refunds are evaluated after full protocol completion, where standardized conditions were honored. Refund evaluation does not depend on research participation status. Refunds do not imply system malfunction or incorrect participation.

settings.title: What Refunds Do Not Imply
settings.body: A refund does not imply: Product failure. Participant failure. Incorrect participation. It reflects respect for the participant's time and commitment.

settings.title: Abuse Protection
settings.body: Repeated enrollment and refund cycling is restricted to protect system integrity.
